name: Haldane Ridge Private Weekend Intensive (immersive format)
summary: Private one-guest weekend with a fixed schedule of conversation, writing, and walking. Your facilitator is with you for every session, including the walks. $1,850.
description:
Haldane Ridge offers private, one-guest weekend intensives in a restored 1920s farmhouse on 60 acres in the Hudson Valley. Each intensive follows a set schedule built around three elements: facilitated conversation, guided writing, and long walks on the property's trails.

**The weekend**

*Friday*
6:00 pm Arrival and dinner with your facilitator
8:00 pm Opening session (60 min)

*Saturday and Sunday morning*
7:00 am Wake
8:30 am Morning session (60 min): conversation with your facilitator
10:00 am Accompanied walk with your facilitator (3 hrs), talking or not
1:00 pm Lunch
2:00 pm Writing with your facilitator present, pausing every 40 minutes to discuss the page
6:00 pm Evening session (60 min)
7:00 pm Dinner

Sunday concludes at 2:00 pm.

**Approach**
This is a talking and writing weekend. There is no meditation instruction and it is not a silent retreat. Our facilitators, Renata Voss (LMHC) and David Okafor (MA, spiritual direction), draw on several traditions without teaching any one of them.

In the immersive format, your facilitator is with you throughout the day, including the walks and the writing. We offer it because many guests who book alone have had enough of working things through alone, and having someone present for all of it is what shifts. Time to yourself can be requested at any point.

**Fit**
Best suited to guests who have done some form of inner work before and are comfortable with sustained one-to-one attention. The trails are hilly and the walks are three hours; guests should be comfortable with that.

**Investment**
$1,850 per weekend, single occupancy, all meals included.
practical: Friday 6pm to Sunday 2pm, most weekends April to October. $1,850, one guest, all meals. Private room and bath. Bring trail shoes, rain layer, and a notebook. Amtrak to Rhinecliff; pickup included. Cell service variable; wifi in the main house.
